title: Canadian Natural Resources Limited Enters into Agreement to Acquire Advantage Energy Ltd.

summary: TORONTO, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Barrick Mining Corporation (NYSE:B)(TSX:ABX) (“Barrick”) announced today that it has agreed to subscribe for 6,638,382 common shares of Hercules Metals Corp. (“Hercules”) in a non-brokered private placement (“Private Placement”) at a price of C$0.87 per common share, for total consideration of approximately C$5,775,392. Barrick's subscription under the Private Placement is being undertaken in accordance with the anti-dilution rights contained in its Investor Rights Agreement with Hercules dated November 7, 2023.
title: Barrick Announces Exercise of Anti-Dilution Rights Under Investor Rights Agreement With Hercules Metals

title: TELUS confirms receipt of unsolicited proposal from Québecor, continues review of strategic alternatives
